options.action: Play

states.title: Start
states.description: You wake up in a dark room. The air is still and heavy, and the silence is unnerving. Somehow, you feel like you've been here before, yet you don't remember why nor how. There's not quite anything to do at the moment, so you might as well explore.

req-desciptions.description: You wake up again in the dark room. Maybe this time you'll learn more about how you got here.
You wake up once again in the dark room for what seems like hundreds of times. Maybe this time you'll finally learn more about how you got here.

options.action: Explore
Gaze into the darkness, hoping to spot something useful
Sit down

states.title: Sat Down
states.description: You sit down, expecting to feel the cold floor beneath your feet. But instead, you find yourself in another dark room. Again.

states.title: Looking Around?
states.description: As you look around, an unknown force suddenly strikes you. In an instant, you feel a cold breeze that quickly envelops you. It seems familiar but also seems to deprive you of your energy. You try to shake it off and focus, hoping to spot a clue amidst the darkness, only to find that the effort makes your head spin. You have no choice but to give up and submit to the darkness.

options.action: Give up
Restart
Restart

states.title: Explored 1
states.description: You make your best effort to explore, but can't find much due to the darkness. However, you do see a small stone on the ground.

options.action: Pick up the stone
Leave the stone behind
Look around to see if there are more objects
Sit down and think about what to do next / how to use it

states.title: Has Stone
states.description: You pick up the stone. It feels smooth and light. The strange thing is, it somehow feels cold to the touch, yet also seems to heat you up. You shrug and put it in your pocket. Maybe you can figure out a way to use it?

options.action: Look around to see if there are more objects
Sit down and think about what to do next / how to use it
Explore the room more

states.title: Explored 2
states.description: You make your best effort to explore, but can't find much due to the darkness. However, you do notice a hard metallic surface. As you feel around, you notice what appears to be a handle.

options.action: Look around to see if there are more objects
Sit down and think about what to do next
Go back and check the stone you ignored
Try to open the metallic door
Touch the door with the Cold Stone
Start a puzzle !?!?!!

states.title: Opened the Door
states.description: You opened the door and won.
